cards.text: COLETTE UGC — PERFECT FALL BAG

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: AIUGC ad, max 50s, 8 fixed 6s segments. Creator A (anchor-locked) on her bedroom floor, single fixed low-angle phone, bag handled TO the lens per the bagtok reference grammar. LAW: the Colette is on screen the ENTIRE runtime — no generic/random-product visuals anywhere; failed-bag lines live in the VO while the picture demonstrates ours. Angle: every fall her bags don't match the season; the Colette is brushed wool so it dresses like her fall clothes do. All frames GENERATED and product-truth QA'd. Ships as 3 creator variants + 3 AI-VO variants. Loro Piana line is an approved exception to the zero-reference rule for these ads only.
Fixed low-angle phone, creator on floor, bag in hand from second one

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
instant credibility — a woman with the bag, in her real room

Note she is handling the product from the first frame. Ours does the same.
Bag pushed INTO the lens, fingers on hardware, face half-cropped

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
tactile proof — the viewer's hands, not a camera move

Copied in our texture beat, medium-close.
Opening the bag toward the camera, both hands working

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
demonstration — she does things to the bag instead of describing it

Demonstrate never describe.

cards.title: REFERENCE GRAMMAR — bagtok organic feel  ·  TikTok @daniellawears bag review · vibe reference only
SCRIPT
cards.text: Okay, if you're looking for the perfect fall bag, I need to show you this.
Creator leans in mid-sentence, Colette lifting into frame in her hands

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text: curiosity — hook; conditional call-out opens the loop, product already arriving

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Every fall it's the same thing. My summer bags look wrong the second the weather turns, and my leather bags just sit on top of everything I wear.
Eye-roll toward the closet, Colette in her lap the whole beat. NO cutaway — the failed bags exist only in the VO

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
recognition — problem agitation; the dismissal is spoken, never shown

BANNED: any shot of another bag. Stay on her + the Colette.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Colette from Velantra. It's clearly inspired by the Loro Piana tote, but they sell it for about a hundred and twenty dollars.
Bag held beside her face, front face square to camera. Post overlay: the Colette · $119.99

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
reveal — dupe-culture credibility anchor plus price shock, said as her observation

This frame is also the identity ANCHOR every segment seeds from.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's brushed wool, so it's cashmere soft, and it goes with the coat, the sweaters, denim, everything I own from September on.
Bag pushed into the lens, fingers denting the wool nap. CUTAWAY 0:21-0:24 to the mirror outfit shot (below) — Colette on her arm

cards.title: EMOTION

tactile want — texture demo; the goes-with-everything mechanism made visible

Medium close, never macro.
0:21-0:24 CUTAWAY

Mirror outfit-check, camel coat + cream knit, Colette on the FOREARM

cards.title: EMOTION

Forearm carry only, never shoulder.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And it stands up on its own. Open top, my laptop slides in with room to spare, real leather handles.
Hands-off moment, Colette standing alone on the carpet. CUTAWAY 0:27-0:30 to laptop drop-in (below)

cards.title: EMOTION

proof — the structure demo answers the slouchy-bag fear

Hold the stillness a beat longer than feels right.
0:27-0:30 CUTAWAY

Top-down laptop sliding into the Colette's open top, slip pocket visible

cards.text: I've carried it every day for two weeks and haven't switched bags once.
Mid-shrug, picking the Colette back up by the handles, tossed-off

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: People keep asking if it's designer. There's no logo anywhere on it.
Front face square to camera, finger tapping the blank wool panel

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Caramel or espresso, and they're doing a pre order right now. Go look at Velantra. The link is right there.
Points down, Colette upright beside her. CUTAWAY 0:43-0:46 to the colors 2-up (below). Post overlay: VELANTRA

Kill the pre order line the day it flips to in-stock.

Caramel + espresso Colettes side by side on the entryway bench

cards.title: OUR VERSION — 8 segments, 50s, GENERATED KEYFRAMES · COLETTE IN EVERY FRAME

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: LAW — PRODUCT ALWAYS ON SCREEN
cards.text: The Colette is in every single frame of this ad. BANNED: generic or random product visuals of any kind (prop bags, competitor-ish bags, graveyard shots, mismatch flat lays). Failed-bag lines are VO-only, delivered over footage of OURS. Background set dressing must be logo-free and soft-focus, never composed as a subject.

cards.title: QA STATUS
cards.text: Every frame passed product truth: belt on the front face through the two vertical straps, SHORT free ends with gold caps, clean wool gussets, no logos, forearm-only carry. One background flag: the blurred checkered bag on the dresser (inherited from anchor) must be swapped or blurred before final renders.

cards.title: ENGINES + VARIANTS
cards.text: Seedance 2.5 lipsync animates creator segments from these keyframes, every segment seeded from the ANCHOR, never chained. Omni animates cutaways. Text overlays in post. Creators B and C re-render this spine after approval or Pinterest refs; 3 AI-VO variants reuse the product beats with an ElevenLabs v3 continuous take.
